title: A customer advisory board for Meridian
variant: Internal: problem, proposal, and outcome as a three-column band
prompt: A one-pager proposing a customer advisory board for our B2B product, for the exec team.
note: Internal register, all sans and tight, with the problem, proposal, and outcome as a three-column band under the headline so an exec sees the argument's shape before reading a word, and the outcome column the only toned cell. Costs and returns are two short lists side by side, the ask is the one heavy-bordered box and carries a date and the three parts of a yes, and the risks are a four-cell strip so the whole page fits one laptop screen.
